summary.text: Tracy Sharp is a Republican state representative from Montana who has represented House District 12 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Air Force veteran with an engineering degree from Purdue University, she serves on the House Judiciary, Fish, Wildlife and Parks, and Energy, Technology, and Federal Relations committees.

paragraphs.text: Tracy Sharp was born in Stanley, Wisconsin, and served in the U.S. Air Force.
She earned a bachelor's degree in aeronautical and astronautical engineering from Purdue University and a graduate degree in military arts and science from the United States Air Force War College.
Sharp won the Republican primary for House District 12 on June 4, 2024, and defeated Democrat Barry Olson in the November 5, 2024 general election.
She assumed office on January 6, 2025, and her current term ends on January 4, 2027.
In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Energy, Technology, and Federal Relations, Fish, Wildlife and Parks, and House Judiciary committees.
She advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026.
